item.title: Ceuta border rush death toll rises to 67; most migrants returned to Morocco
item.description: Spain's Interior Ministry reports 67 deaths after about 50,000 people entered the enclave since Thursday, with most being sent back.

item.title: Iran updates: Trump considers strikes on Iranian energy sites, officials say
item.description: President Trump announced 'major combat operations' against Iran on Feb. 28, involving large-scale joint U.S.-Israeli strikes.

item.title: Tony Romo takes leave after DUI arrest video surfaces
item.description: Former NFL quarterback Tony Romo is on leave following the release of his DUI arrest video.

item.title: Connecticut man recounts shark attack while snorkeling in Bahamas
item.description: A husband and father describes being bitten by a Caribbean reef shark during a snorkeling trip in the Bahamas.
